name: skilder
description: Connect any agent to a Skilder workspace, where AI builders orchestrate the capabilities their agents use: plugins composed of skills, MCP tools and MCP Apps, served live over MCP and governed there.

interface.longDescription: Skilder brings your team's skills to ChatGPT, the same ones your other agents use. Your team writes its skills, tools and MCP Apps once in a Skilder workspace and groups them into plugins. ChatGPT, Codex and any other MCP client the team uses read those same plugins. When a skill changes in the workspace, every agent gets the new version on its next task, with nothing to reinstall. In ChatGPT, you sign in once. For each task, Skilder suggests the plugin that fits, and ChatGPT follows its skills, calls its tools and opens its MCP Apps in the conversation. The workspace stays in charge. Admins decide who gets which plugin, guardrails check tool calls before they run, and every call is recorded in Activity, whichever agent made it. Requires a Skilder account: get started at docs.skilder.ai.
defaultPrompt: Get started with Skilder: show what my workspace holds and run a first task.
Use Skilder to find the plugin that fits this task and do it with its skills, tools and Apps.
Turn this conversation into a Skilder skill my team can reuse.
